text: 9月8日，糖产业指数大涨5.94%，粤桂股份、中粮糖业涨停。消息面上，据多家媒体报道，全球第二产糖国泰国的糖产量在新榨季可能至少下降17%，全球糖供应面临的压力或将进一步加大。某糖产业头部上市公司人士回应称，北半球今年的榨季还没有开始，泰国和我国甘蔗榨季时间基本一致，因此目前还不好做出判断。“一般而言，甘蔗榨季是从当年11月份到第二年的2月份、3月份，榨好的糖第二年销售。”粤桂股份方面回应称。
text_en: On September 8, the sugar industry index jumped 5.94%, with Yuegui Co., Ltd. and COFCO Sugar hitting the daily limit. On the news front, according to multiple media reports, sugar output in Thailand, the world's second-largest sugar producer, may fall by at least 17% in the new crushing season, potentially intensifying pressure on global sugar supply. A source from a leading sugar industry listed company responded that the Northern Hemisphere's crushing season has not yet begun this year, and Thailand's and China's sugarcane crushing seasons are basically aligned, so it is still hard to make a judgment. 'Generally, the sugarcane crushing season runs from November to February or March of the following year, with the crushed sugar sold the following year,' Yuegui Co., Ltd. responded.
